thm affine_parallelogram_witness:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
        c(1) = ((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1))
        c(2) = ((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2))
        =>:
            $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
    release thm f1::triangle_vertices_distinct(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    by contra:
        ? d != c
        d = c
        c(1) = d(1)
        c(2) = d(2)
        b(1) = ((((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - d(1)) + a(1)) = ((c(1) - d(1)) + a(1)) = ((d(1) - d(1)) + a(1)) = a(1)
        b(2) = ((((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - d(2)) + a(2)) = ((c(2) - d(2)) + a(2)) = ((d(2) - d(2)) + a(2)) = a(2)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = (((a(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((a(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = 0
        impossible m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    by contra:
        ? b != c
        b = c
        c(1) = b(1)
        c(2) = b(2)
        d(1) = ((((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) + a(1)) = ((c(1) - b(1)) + a(1)) = ((b(1) - b(1)) + a(1)) = a(1)
        d(2) = ((((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) + a(2)) = ((c(2) - b(2)) + a(2)) = ((b(2) - b(2)) + a(2)) = a(2)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (a(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (a(1) - a(1)))) = 0
        impossible m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    (c(1) - d(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - d(1)) = (b(1) - a(1))
    (c(1) - b(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) = (d(1) - a(1))
    (c(2) - d(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - d(2)) = (b(2) - a(2))
    (c(2) - b(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) = (d(2) - a(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    m0::f0::vec(a, b)(1) = (b(1) - a(1))
    m0::f0::vec(a, b)(2) = (b(2) - a(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(a, d)
    m0::f0::vec(a, d)(1) = (d(1) - a(1))
    m0::f0::vec(a, d)(2) = (d(2) - a(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(d, c)
    m0::f0::vec(d, c)(1) = (c(1) - d(1))
    m0::f0::vec(d, c)(2) = (c(2) - d(2))
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(b, c)
    m0::f0::vec(b, c)(1) = (c(1) - b(1))
    m0::f0::vec(b, c)(2) = (c(2) - b(2))
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(d, c))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(d, c)) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (c(2) - d(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (c(1) - d(1)))) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (b(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (b(1) - a(1)))) = 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(a, b, d, c)
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(b, c))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(b, c)) = (((d(1) - a(1)) * (c(2) - b(2))) - ((d(2) - a(2)) * (c(1) - b(1)))) = (((d(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((d(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(a, d, b, c)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, d, b)
    release thm m0::f0::det_antisymmetric(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b))
    by contra:
        ? m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b)) != 0
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b)) = 0
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = (-(-m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)))) = (-m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b))) = (-0) = 0
        impossible m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    by def $f0::are_parallel_lines(a, b, d, c)
    by def $f0::are_parallel_lines(a, d, b, c)
    by def $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)

thm affine_parallelogram_area:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
        c(1) = ((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1))
        c(2) = ((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2))
        =>:
            exist common R+ st {$f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, common), $f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, (2 * common))}
    release thm affine_parallelogram_witness(a, b, c, d)
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(b, c, d)
    (c(1) - b(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) = (d(1) - a(1))
    (c(2) - b(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) = (d(2) - a(2))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) = (((c(1) - b(1)) * (d(2) - b(2))) - ((c(2) - b(2)) * (d(1) - b(1)))) = (((d(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - b(2))) - ((d(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - b(1)))) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) != 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_triangle(b, c, d)
    have common R+ = f2::triangle_area(a, b, d)
    $f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, common)
    by def $f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, common)
    (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2) = (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) ^ 2)
    (2 * common) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) ^ 2)) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2))
    by def $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, common)
    witness exist first, second R+ st {$f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, first), $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, second), (2 * common) = (first + second)} from common, common
    by def $f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, (2 * common))
    witness exist half R+ st {$f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, half), $f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, (2 * half))} from common

thm parallelogram_coordinate_closure:
    ? forall par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d cart(R, R):
        $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d)
        =>:
            par_d(1) = ((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1))
            par_d(2) = ((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2))
    thm local_independent_directions_force_zero_offset:
        ? forall u1, u2, v1, v2, k1, k2 R:
            ((u1 * v2) - (u2 * v1)) != 0
            ((u1 * k2) - (u2 * k1)) = 0
            ((v1 * k2) - (v2 * k1)) = 0
            =>:
                k1 = 0
                k2 = 0
        have determinant R = ((u1 * v2) - (u2 * v1))
        determinant != 0
        (determinant * k1) = (((u1 * v2) - (u2 * v1)) * k1) = ((v1 * ((u1 * k2) - (u2 * k1))) - (u1 * ((v1 * k2) - (v2 * k1)))) = ((v1 * 0) - (u1 * 0)) = 0
        (determinant * k2) = (((u1 * v2) - (u2 * v1)) * k2) = ((v2 * ((u1 * k2) - (u2 * k1))) - (u2 * ((v1 * k2) - (v2 * k1)))) = ((v2 * 0) - (u2 * 0)) = 0
        k1 = ((determinant * k1) / determinant) = (0 / determinant) = 0
        k2 = ((determinant * k2) / determinant) = (0 / determinant) = 0
    by def $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d)
    $f0::are_parallel_lines(par_a, par_b, par_d, par_c)
    by def $f0::are_parallel_lines(par_a, par_b, par_d, par_c)
    $f0::are_parallel_lines(par_a, par_d, par_b, par_c)
    by def $f0::are_parallel_lines(par_a, par_d, par_b, par_c)
    $m0::f0::is_parallel(par_a, par_b, par_d, par_c)
    by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(par_a, par_b, par_d, par_c)
    $m0::f0::is_parallel(par_a, par_d, par_b, par_c)
    by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(par_a, par_d, par_b, par_c)
    have u1 R = (par_b(1) - par_a(1))
    have u2 R = (par_b(2) - par_a(2))
    have v1 R = (par_d(1) - par_a(1))
    have v2 R = (par_d(2) - par_a(2))
    have k1 R = (((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) - par_d(1))
    have k2 R = (((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) - par_d(2))
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(par_a, par_b, par_d)
    ((u1 * v2) - (u2 * v1)) = (((par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_d(2) - par_a(2))) - ((par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_d(1) - par_a(1)))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d)) != 0
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(par_a, par_b)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(par_a, par_d)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(par_d, par_c)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(par_b, par_c)
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_d, par_c))
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d), m0::f0::vec(par_b, par_c))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_d, par_c)) = (((par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_d(2))) - ((par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_d(1))))
    (((par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_d(2))) - ((par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_d(1)))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_d, par_c)) = 0
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d), m0::f0::vec(par_b, par_c)) = (((par_d(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_b(2))) - ((par_d(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_b(1))))
    (((par_d(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_b(2))) - ((par_d(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_b(1)))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d), m0::f0::vec(par_b, par_c)) = 0
    ((u1 * k2) - (u2 * k1)) = (((par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) - par_d(2))) - ((par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) - par_d(1)))) = (((par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_d(2))) - ((par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_d(1)))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_d, par_c)) = 0
    ((v1 * k2) - (v2 * k1)) = (((par_d(1) - par_a(1)) * (((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) - par_d(2))) - ((par_d(2) - par_a(2)) * (((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) - par_d(1)))) = (((par_d(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_b(2))) - ((par_d(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_b(1)))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d), m0::f0::vec(par_b, par_c)) = 0
    release thm local_independent_directions_force_zero_offset(u1, u2, v1, v2, k1, k2)
    ((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) = ((((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) - par_d(1)) + par_d(1)) = (k1 + par_d(1)) = (0 + par_d(1)) = par_d(1)
    ((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) = ((((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) - par_d(2)) + par_d(2)) = (k2 + par_d(2)) = (0 + par_d(2)) = par_d(2)

thm parallelogram_area_is_absolute_determinant:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R), total R+:
        $f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, total)
        =>:
            total = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) ^ 2))
    by def $f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, total)
    $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
    release thm parallelogram_coordinate_closure(a, b, c, d)
    c(1) = ((b(1) + ((a(1) + c(1)) - b(1))) - a(1)) = ((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1))
    c(2) = ((b(2) + ((a(2) + c(2)) - b(2))) - a(2)) = ((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2))
    have u cart(R, R) = m0::f0::vec(a, b)
    have v cart(R, R) = m0::f0::vec(a, d)
    (m0::f0::det(u, v) ^ 2) >= 0
    by def $f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, total)
    obtain first, second from exist x, y R+ st {$f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, x), $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, y), total = (x + y)}
    by def $f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, first)
    by def $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, second)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(b, c, d)
    (c(1) - b(1)) = (((b(1) + d(1)) - a(1)) - b(1)) = (d(1) - a(1))
    (c(2) - b(2)) = (((b(2) + d(2)) - a(2)) - b(2)) = (d(2) - a(2))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) = (((c(1) - b(1)) * (d(2) - b(2))) - ((c(2) - b(2)) * (d(1) - b(1)))) = (((d(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - b(2))) - ((d(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - b(1)))) = (((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(2) - a(2))) - ((b(2) - a(2)) * (d(1) - a(1)))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = m0::f0::det(u, v)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) = m0::f0::det(u, v)
    (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) ^ 2) = (m0::f0::det(u, v) ^ 2)
    (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) ^ 2) >= 0
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) = m0::f0::det(u, v)
    (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2) = (m0::f0::det(u, v) ^ 2)
    (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2) >= 0
    (2 * first) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, d)) ^ 2)) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(u, v) ^ 2))
    (2 * second) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2)) = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(u, v) ^ 2))
    have twice_area R = sqrt ((m0::f0::det(u, v) ^ 2))
    (2 * first) = twice_area
    (2 * second) = twice_area
    total = (first + second) = (((2 * first) + (2 * second)) / 2) = ((twice_area + twice_area) / 2) = twice_area
